description.value: Salita Cyclery is a road and gravel cycling boutique in Burnaby Heights, taking its name from the Italian word for 'ascend' as a nod to local mountain climbs and the Italian heritage of North Burnaby. The shop carries premium brands including Orbea, Felt, Argon 18, De Rosa, and Pinarello, and offers professional repair and custom build services by appointment. It also serves as the base for Hewdog Racing, a cycling and triathlon team, making it a genuine community hub for competitive road and multisport athletes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Salita Cyclery as a road/gravel/triathlon-focused bike boutique at 4485 Hastings St., Burnaby, BC V5C 0L6 — contradicting OSM's community field of 'North Vancouver.' The service page explicitly states walk-in same-day service is not available except for flat tire tube repairs, which informs the required criteria and walk-in/same-day amenity fields. No evidence was found for pump, touring parts, washrooms, rentals, or other amenities not mentioned on the site.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the website consistently identifies the business as located in Burnaby, BC (every page title reads 'Salita Cyclery | Burnaby, BC' and the postal code V5C 0L6 is Burnaby). The OSM community tag should be corrected to Burnaby.

The website's location subpage (/about/location-pg141.htm) lists the address as '4489 Hastings St.' in one heading, while the footer and all other pages consistently show '4485 Hastings St.' This is a minor internal inconsistency; 4485 appears to be correct.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active local bike shop offering sales, professional repair, and parts — a useful resource for touring cyclists needing mechanical support or parts in the Burnaby/East Vancouver corridor.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: Same-day service confirmed for flat tire tube repairs only. All other work requires booking with 2+ week lead time and 7–10 day turnaround
